summary: Iteration 17 — split of /api/contacts, /api/notifications, /api/deals into /app/backend/routes/*.py and NEW moderation feature (signalements posts/comments) validated end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (1 skipped: contacts already connected from previous run). Iter16 regression suite re-run green (29/29). Frontend: admin /admin/reports page renders the 4 tabs with correct counts matching backend, header admin menu contains 'Signalements', feed '...' menu exposes 'Signaler' on other-user posts, and the full Signaler flow (window.prompt × 2 → POST /api/reports → toast 'Signalement transmis à la modération') was executed successfully and verified via /api/reports/mine (rep_02987f4c1587, reason=harassment).
critical_code_review_comments: MODEL DUPLICATION (still applies from iter16) — Pydantic models PostIn/PostMedia/LinkPreview/CommentIn/MessageIn/MessageAttachment exist in BOTH server.py and routes/posts.py + routes/messages.py. New iter17 models ContactRequestIn and DealIn correctly live in /app/backend/models.py and are imported by both server.py (in case still referenced) and routes/*. Recommend moving the post/message models there too.

ROUTER NAMING — all 7 routers (ads/posts/messages/contacts/notifications/deals/moderation) still register on the same APIRouter instance (ads_api). Single shared router works but is misleading; consider one APIRouter per module included on the main app for cleaner mounting and easier prefix changes.

SERVER.PY SIZE — Down to ~3650 lines (good progress, -547 cumulative since iter15). Remaining big inline blocks: /api/auth/*, /api/users/*, /api/offers/*, /api/applications/*, /api/cv/*, /api/messages-rt/* WebSocket. Continue extracting to hit the <700 lines/file guideline.

REASON i18n LEAK — REASONS list is in English ('spam','harassment',...) but the user prompt and the admin row badges display in French; mapping is implicit. Consider storing a (slug, fr_label, en_label) triple or a constant map for clearer maintenance.
MODERATION endpoint POST /admin/reports/{id}/dismiss & /remove accept body: dict (no Pydantic validation). Switch to small DismissIn / RemoveIn models for shape safety.

POST /api/posts/comment uses body.post_id rather than the more REST-y /api/posts/{post_id}/comments — the GET side uses the path form, leading to asymmetry that already tripped a regression test. Consider keeping both for back-compat then deprecating /posts/comment.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (admin reports page, header menu, feed Signaler menu, full report submission e2e)
